import hashlib,json,os,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/lucky/devdir/rgzndl/results/paper_components/acceptance_v1')
r=json.loads((folder/'report.json').read_text());proof=json.loads((folder/'verification.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert proof['status']=='passed' and proof['report_sha256']==sha(folder/'report.json')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as config:
 os.environ['MPLCONFIGDIR']=config
 import matplotlib
 matplotlib.use('Agg')
 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 history=r['history'];epochs=[x['epochs_completed'] for x in history]
 fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,4),layout='constrained')
 axes[0].plot(epochs,[x['last_batch_loss'] for x in history],marker='o',color='#426e9c')
 axes[0].set_ylabel('Cross-entropy, last random-crop batch');axes[0].set_xlabel('Epoch');axes[0].set_title('Training loss')
 axes[1].plot([0]+epochs,[100*r['initial_train_subset_metrics']['accuracy']]+[100*x['train_subset_metrics']['accuracy'] for x in history],marker='o',color='#c8843b')
 axes[1].axhline(95,color='#888',ls='--',label='Pre-registered memory goal: 95%')
 axes[1].set_ylim(0,105);axes[1].set_ylabel('Accuracy on the same 40 training samples (%)');axes[1].set_xlabel('Epoch');axes[1].set_title('Frozen 10-crop inference');axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
 fig.suptitle('Paper component acceptance: 40 training samples',fontsize=13)
 fig.text(.01,-.04,'Training memory check only. No validation/test inference and no claim of generalization or paper-score reproduction.',fontsize=9)
 files={}
 for ext in ('png','svg'):
  p=folder/f'learning_acceptance.{ext}';fig.savefig(p,dpi=180,bbox_inches='tight')
  if ext=='svg':p.write_text('\n'.join(x.rstrip() for x in p.read_text().splitlines())+'\n',newline='\n')
  files[p.name]=sha(p)
 plt.close(fig)
 provenance=dict(report_sha256=sha(folder/'report.json'),verification_sha256=sha(folder/'verification.json'),
  script=Path(__file__).read_text(),script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),matplotlib_version=matplotlib.__version__,files_sha256=files)
 (folder/'figure_provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\n',newline='\n')
 print('Generated acceptance PNG/SVG')
